race.comment: PHINEAS (6) drifted well back last start before storming home to score this course and distance. More weight but racing well and will prove tough to hold out again. MYSTIC WONDER (4) finished 3.5 lengths away in eighth in stakes grade last time out over 1400m on the Parks track a week ago. Tackles a longer journey this time bit on the quick back-up in easier class. Good record at this journey with two wins and three minor placings from six starts and can atone. BRAVE STAR (5) wound up strongly last time out to finish on the heels of PHINEAS and meets the winner better at the weights. Winning rider Jason Holder stays aboard. Expected to measure up. LOMAX (7) turned things around last start and got the job done by 1.2 lengths over 1600m at this track. Another hard to hold out. HARD PRINCE (9) has a sound second-up record and is definitely worth including.
